text:
nur: Quick thread - PM report: some enterprise customers confused by 'Scope' label in Roles UI. They thought it's model scope.
leo: Rename to 'Route scopes' + short help text. Also add example: '/generate, /embeddings/*'.
priya: Need to link role evaluation to quota decisions for cost debugging. Right now logs only show fallback events without role attribution.
console-bot: UX idea: small "why allowed" pill in role flyout showing matched_scope + rule id. Clickable to copy trace.
nur: API change proposal: GET /admin/v1/roles?tenant=...&include=trace - returns compact trace (matched_scope, rule_id, reason). Keep default off to avoid payload bloat. Example: {roles:[{"id":"r_21","name":"Billing","priority":40,"scopes":["route:/invoices"],"trace":{"matched_scope":"route:/invoices","rule_id":"rl_7","reason":"explicit_allow"}}]}
leo: Telemetry event 'rbac.role_eval' fields: tenant, route, role_id, matched_scope, outcome(allow|deny|fallback), quota_bucket, sampled. Default sampling 0.5%. Allow admin override per tenant.
telemetry-bot: note: including role_id in telemetry triggers privacy review. Suggest obfuscating role_name and only sending role_id + tenant.
priya: Backend note: generating trace touches authz cache. Make trace generation lazy and on-demand (include=trace or X-RBAC-Debug header). Also provide /admin/v1/route_traces?routes=... batch endpoint.
nur: Rollout flags: rbac.ui_trace + rbac.api_trace. Canary 10% for 48h -> 50% for 7d -> GA. Add sampling control and per-tenant override.
leo: Console: under route debug show small timeline: requests -> matched role -> quota bucket. Use pre-aggregated counters to avoid heavy queries.
priya: Let's keep API field name 'trace' not 'eval_trace' - shorter and clear.
console-bot: UX test: will run 120 participants in Maze for copy variants.
